release_note_text: BlueFS increases the default WAL volume size to 1GB to reduce the risk of ENOSPC failure due to insufficient WAL space. (Architecture-related: BlueFS storage backend capacity configuration)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: BlueFS storage backend capacity configuration

release_note_text: Fix the usage problem of bluestore_volume_selection_reserved_factor in BlueStore/BlueFS volume selection logic, and improve the hierarchical naming and space judgment of RocksDBBlueFSVolumeSelector. (Architecture-related: BlueFS volume selection logic)
A new time_added field is added to the Monitor information structure to prevent newly added monitors from being prematurely judged as MON_DOWN. (Architecture-related: Monitor health status judgment)

Fix the problem that the set feature is not correctly applied when monmaptool adds an address, and ensure that the monitor address feature configuration takes effect as expected. (Architecture-related: Monitor address feature configuration)

Fixed an issue where the offset and length parameters were in reverse order when WriteOp.zero() called the underlying C API in the RADOS Python binding. (Architecture-related: Python client API behavior)

mgr changes to clearing health indicators when dealing with down/out OSDs instead of removing the OSD from the daemon state to preserve the consistency of the daemon state. (Architecture-related: Manager daemon health state)
Fix pg_autoscale_mode output logic so that both standard output and JSON output can correctly reflect the no_autoscale flag. (Architecture-related: PG autoscaler management interface output)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: PG autoscaler management interface output

release_note_text: Fix the problem of reserved_size drift of 2pc_queue in the RGW notification queue and non-deduction of commit/abort path resources to avoid false positives of ENOSPC. (Architecture-related: RGW notification queue resource count)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: RGW notification queue resource count

release_note_text: Fixed an issue where tags could not be read correctly for RGW objects created through multi-part uploads. (Architecture-related: S3 multi-part upload object tag behavior)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: S3 multipart upload object tag behavior

release_note_text: Updated the Kafka version support used by RGW Kafka testing/integration to 3.9.2. (Architecture-related: RGW notification dependency compatibility)

Simplify frag_t printing logic, and fix frag_t byte order conversion in network transmission and storage to improve cross-platform consistency. (Architecture-related: frag_t serialization compatibility)

Updated Ceph FUSE client related instructions to clarify that fallocate disk space reservation is only supported under specific flag combinations. (Architecture-related: CephFS FUSE client usage constraints)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: CephFS FUSE client usage constraints

release_note_text: MDS status and metadata output adds system information and dumps frag_t in object form to improve diagnostic readability. (Architecture-related: MDS status and metadata output)
architecture_label: Schema related: MDS status and metadata output

release_note_text: Fixed the problem of incorrectly creating a new MDS service when Dashboard modifies MDS placement to label. (Architecture-related: Dashboard service orchestration behavior)

Fixed the problem of Dashboard's role-based access control permissions, and added the missing type information in the mgr-module list. (Architecture-related: Dashboard permissions and mgr module interface)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: Dashboard permissions and mgr module interface

release_note_text: librbd adds RBD_LOCK_MODE_EXCLUSIVE_TRANSIENT lock mode, which allows other peers to wait while manually holding an exclusive lock briefly, instead of immediately interrupting I/O. (Architecture-related: librbd exclusive lock API behavior)
architecture_label: Architecture-related: librbd exclusive lock API behavior
